name: glitchsecure-website
author: Glitch Secure Labs
description: Company website built using Jekyll and TailwindCSS

scripts.start: npx esbuild vendor/*.js --outfile=assets/js/bundle.js --bundle && bundle exec jekyll serve --livereload --drafts --future --port 4061 --livereload_port 35729
scripts.build: npx esbuild vendor/*.js --outfile=assets/js/bundle.js --bundle && JEKYLL_ENV=production bundle exec jekyll build
